small, resumable pipeline for turning a large podcast (or any large audio) archive into something you can actually search and ask questions of — transcription, structured summaries, semantic search, and grounded Q&A, all scripted around the OpenAI API. Built to process 230 episodes (\~145 hours of audio) for about $33 total. Full writeup of how it works and what broke along the way: see [technicalblog.html](/snowmac/castrag/blob/main/technicalblog.html) (open it directly in a browser, or publish it wherever you like). Why this exists Feeding a large transcript archive into an LLM's context window doesn't scale, and reading it yourself doesn't either. This pipeline gives you three ways to actually use a large audio archive: 1. Structured summaries — a fast, cheap overview per episode (topics, quotes, takeaways, tone) 2. Semantic search — embed everything once, then find the exact passage relevant to any question in milliseconds 3. RAGbased Q&A — ask a naturallanguage question and get an answer grounded in, and cited to, the actual source material — no hallucinated advice Pipeline transcribe.py mp3s → transcripts/.txt build_index.py transcripts → index/ (embeddings + metadata) summarize.py transcripts → summaries/.json ask.py question → cited answer (stdout) analyze_themes.py summaries → themes.json (crosscorpus synthesis) Every script only reads from the previous stage's output directory and only writes to its own — nothing is ever mutated in place, and every script skips work that's already done. That means you can kill any stage midrun, add more source files later, or swap models between batches, and just rerun. Setup python3 m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate pip install r requirements.txt brew install ffmpeg or your platform's equivalent Create a .env file in the project root: OPENAI_API_KEY=sk... Usage 1. Drop your audio files into audiofiles/, then: python transcribe.py 2. Generate perepisode structured summaries: python summarize.py 3. Build the semantic search index: python build_index.py 4. Ask questions grounded in the transcripts: python ask.py "what did they say about X?" 5. (Optional) synthesize themes across the whole corpus: python analyze_themes.py summarize.py and analyze_themes.py both have a short constant near the top (SHOW_DESCRIPTION, FOCUS_THEMES) you should edit to match your own show and what you actually want extracted — they ship with generic placeholders, not any specific podcast's content. Notes on cost and models Transcription defaults to gpt4ominitranscribe; whisper1 also works and may transcribe slightly better for noisy audio, at roughly double the perminute cost. Source files get chunked to \~15minute, 64kbps mono segments before upload — this keeps you well under API filesize limits and works for any audio length. Concurrency is capped at two levels (files × chunksperfile) to stay under provider rate limits without going fully sequential. Tune FILE_WORKERS / CHUNK_WORKERS_PER_FILE in transcribe.py for your own rate limit tier. The search index is a single numpy array + JSON metadata file — no vector database needed until you're well past tens of thousands of chunks. items.author: snow_mac
items.descZh: castrag 是一个面向大型播客或音频档案的可恢复处理管道，旨在解决将海量录音直接喂给大模型时面临的上下文窗口限制和人工阅读效率低下的问题。其核心功能覆盖从音频转录、结构化摘要生成、语义索引构建到基于 RAG 的自然语言问答的完整链路，每个阶段由独立脚本驱动，只读取前序输出并写入自身目录，支持中断续跑、增量添加源文件以及按批次更换模型。项目亮点在于经济性与工程简洁性的平衡：实测处理 230 集约 145 小时音频的总成本仅约 33 美元，搜索索引仅需单个 numpy 数组加 JSON 元数据文件，在数万chunk规模以内无需引入向量数据库。它适合拥有大量历史音频内容、希望以低成本实现“按语义秒级定位原声片段”和“引用式问答”的个人创作者或小型团队。
items.quote: 专为处理230集（约145小时音频）而构建，总成本约33美元。
items.titleZh: 展示 HN：Castrag – 转录并语义搜索大型播客存档

items.descZh: Napkin 是一款专为临时暂存文本和图片而设计的轻量化草稿纸工具，旨在帮助用户避免创建和整理繁琐的临时文件。它允许用户将文本和图像保存在一个简单的暂存空间中，以便稍后复制或在不再需要时随时丢弃，实现无痕的临时数据管理。相比于传统系统剪贴板（Clipboard）仅限即时复制粘贴且具有高度易失性（volatile）的局限，Napkin 提供了更具持久性和可视化的临时存储方案。该产品特别适用于需要频繁跨应用处理碎片化文本与图片、追求高效临时暂存且厌恶复杂文件归档的办公与创意场景。

items.title: Show HN: SubRead: line up an audiobook with its eBook, in the browser
items.desc: description: Line an audiobook up with its ebook, sentence by sentence. Get an SRT for readalong, or a video with subtitles. title: SubRead — read along with your audiobook image: https://subread.space/og.png Drop in an audiobook and the ebook it was read from. You get back subtitles timed to the narration, with the wording taken from your own book — not from a machine's guess at what it heard. The work happens in this tab, on your computer. HoshiReader readalong — the .srt timing file, to match against your epub. free Readalong book — your epub with the narration inside it (EPUB 3 Media Overlays). Thorium, Storyteller and other EPUB 3 readers highlight each line as it is read. free Local video — an .mkv with the subtitles built in, for MPV or VLC. free YouTube video — a clean .mp4, plus the .srt to upload as its captions. free Free in your browser, without limit. Convert in this browser (JavaScript) free The JavaScript version does not use any cloud credits. Drop your audiobook _and_ ebook here One at a time or both at once — order doesn't matter. A folder of perchapter files works too. Or browse. Audio: m4b · mp3 · m4a · opus · flac · wav · mkv Book: epub · fb2 · mobi · azw3 · txt Optional: drop a jpg or png to use as the video background — sign in required Audiobook Waiting for an audio file × Cover image Waiting for an image × Book Waiting for an ebook × Getting ready… 0% Ready to align Audiobook Book Language Start alignment Discard Starting Stop (progress is kept) Videos are made here when you ask for them, in seconds. They are not kept anywhere: make them before closing this tab. SubRead is free, and it has no ads. [Chip in for the server on Kofi](https://kofi.com/truex), if it helped. Convert another book Your conversions × Sign in We email you a onetime link. There is no password. Email me a link × Share on honjimaku [honjimaku.com](https://honjimaku.com) is a free library of subtitles for Japanese audiobooks. Other learners can then read along with this book and do not have to make the subtitles again. Title of the book, as the audiobook shop writes it Audiobook ID, if there is one (Audible ASIN, audiobook.jp number) Your honjimaku API key ([make an account, then "Generate API key"](https://honjimaku.com/account)) The key stays in this browser. The subtitles go from this tab to honjimaku.com and to nowhere else. They hold the words of the book: share them only if you may. Share the subtitles × Credits for our server Paid through Stripe; we never see your card. One credit converts one book on our server, with every output. Credits in a pack never expire, and a job that fails gives its credit back. A monthly plan renews each month until you cancel it with "Manage plan"; its books do not carry over to the next month. In this tab a conversion is always free. Paying also creates your account, under the email you give Stripe.
items.author: equwal
items.descZh: SubRead是一个基于浏览器的免费工具，旨在将有声书与电子书逐句对齐，提供精准的阅读同步体验。核心功能包括上传音频和电子书文件后，自动生成时间同步的字幕，支持SRT格式用于阅读同步或内嵌视频字幕。亮点在于其处理速度极快，视频生成仅需几秒，且完全本地化运行，无需云服务或付费。适用场景广泛，包括语言学习、有声书阅读辅助以及内容创作，特别适合需要精确跟随叙述的用户。此外，工具支持多种文件格式，并可与社区库如honjimaku.com集成，促进字幕分享。
items.quote: 导入一本有声书以及朗读该有声书所依据的电子书。您将获得与旁白同步的字幕，其措辞取自您自己的书籍——而不是来自机器生成的文本。
items.titleZh: 展示 HN：SubRead：在浏览器中将有声书与电子书对齐

items.title: Show HN: Sbm: plain-text bookmarks synced across terminal, browser, Android
items.desc: description: Sync your sbm bookmarks between the terminal, the browser addon and Android. title: sbm Sync image: https://sbmsync.com/og.png Your bookmarks, the same everywhere [sbm](https://github.com/equwal/sbm) keeps your bookmarks in one plain text file. sbm Sync keeps that file the same on each of your devices: bm on your computers, the sbm app for Android, and the sbm addon for Firefox and Chrome. You can also use your bookmarks on this site, in any browser. [Create an account](/signup) or [sign in](/login). Teams Coming: bookmarks for teams. The members of a team share one bookmark file, and sync it on each of their devices. Preorder the founding plan: [for up to 10 people](https://buy.stripe.com/14A00j1pV9E6fRh3PEaAw00), or [for 11 people or more](https://buy.stripe.com/dRm9ATfgLeYqeNdcmaaAw01). sbm Sync is free. To pay for the server and the work on sbm, [become a supporter](https://buy.stripe.com/14AeVd6Kf17AcF5euiaAw02). sbm Sync is free software under the AGPL3.0\. You can [run your own server](https://github.com/equwal/sbmsync).

Generates 21,000+ unique, SEOoptimized static HTML pages — daily horoscopes, zodiac guides, planetary aspects, transits, and house pages — with real ephemeris data computed via Swiss Ephemeris (Moshier fallback), requiring no ephemeris data files. Built to power [tianjiastrology.com](https://www.tianjiastrology.com/?utm%5Fsource=github&utm%5Fmedium=readme&utm%5Fcampaign=oss) — AI astrology readings & birth charts. What it does Daily horoscopes for all 12 zodiac signs, regenerated per UTC date, with live ephemeris blocks (Moon sign, retrogrades, ingresses). Zodiac guides, aspect pages, transit pages (planetinsign per year), and house pages — a full pSEO content matrix. Every page ships: unique <title/meta description/canonical URL, JSONLD structured data, reviewed_at timestamps, computed wholesignhouse data, and internal related links. Emits a full sitemap.xml. ZeroCJK output gate: hardfails the build if any nonASCII leaks into HTML. Pure Python stdlib + pyswisseph — deterministic, fast, offline. Usage pip install pyswisseph Generate today's 12 daily horoscope pages + refresh sitemap python3 tj_pseo_gen.py daily out ./dist date "$(date u +%F)" Generate a batch of additional content pages (guides → aspects → transits) python3 tj_pseo_gen.py batch out ./dist n 40 Serve the output directory with any static file server and point your sitemap at it. See [RUNBOOK.md](/feifeizhao25shipit/astrologypseogenerator/blob/main/RUNBOOK.md) for operational details (categories, URL prefixes, deployment notes). items.descZh: astrologypseogenerator是一个开源项目，旨在为占星内容提供程序化SEO静态网站生成服务，背景是支持tianjiastrology.com等平台的占星需求。核心功能包括生成每日星座运势、星座指南、行星方面、行运和宫位页面，所有内容均基于Swiss Ephemeris实时计算星历数据，无需外部文件。亮点在于能快速生成超过21,000个唯一的SEO优化静态HTML页面，每个页面包含自定义元数据、JSON-LD结构化数据和内部链接，性能高效、离线运行且确定性强，同时设有零CJK输出门控确保字符一致性。适用场景主要是需要大规模占星内容的静态网站，如AI占星阅读和出生图服务。
items.quote: 可生成 21,000+ 个唯一的、经过 SEO 优化的静态 HTML 页面。

[](https://www.python.org/) [](https://www.anthropic.com/claude) [](https://inspect.aisi.org.uk/) [](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless) [](results) [](status) [📋 The plan](/ninjahawk/livenerf/blob/main/PLAN.md) · [📊 Results](results) · [🔬 How it works](howitworks) · [🧪 Preregistration](preregistration) livenerf is a small, boring, appendonly benchmark for one question: does a model get worse after it ships? For months there have been reports that Anthropic "nerfs" models some days or weeks after release. That could mean quantization, a smaller model behind the same name, lower effort, or routing changes. It could also mean nothing happened and people are patternmatching on noise. Nobody has had a clean day0 baseline to check against, so every argument ends up as vibes versus vibes. Claude Opus 5.5 came out on 20260922, so this is a chance to start the clock on launch day and keep it running. Right now v0 runs on a Claude Max subscription through headless Claude Code (claude p), with no API key. You can't make these models deterministic: sampling params are gone and thinking can't be turned off. So livenerf makes everything _else_ deterministic: frozen prompts, pinned CLI, exact graders, raw logs forever. It then measures drift statistically over thousands of samples. It's built on [Inspect](https://inspect.aisi.org.uk/), the UK AI Security Institute's opensource eval framework. The stats follow Anthropic's own [Adding Error Bars to Evals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.00640), so there's nothing homebrew to argue about. For questions about the repo, open a thread in the [Discussions tab](https://github.com/ninjahawk/livenerf/discussions) or an [issue](https://github.com/ninjahawk/livenerf/issues). Status Day 0\. The v0 harness is built and tested: an Inspect provider for claude p, four task families with purefunction scorers, the hourly scheduler, and the paireddifference analysis. Two 20sample pilots have run on the public panel. The first came back 20/20, so the generators were made much harder. The second showed that safetyclassifier stops make Claude Code retry and sometimes silently fall back to an older model (Opus 4.8), so those samples are now rejected instead of scored. One more calibration round is needed before the frozen panel is committed (see [docs/PILOT.md](/ninjahawk/livenerf/blob/main/docs/PILOT.md)). The frozenpanel series starts once the secret is committed on the machine that will run it for the long haul. Nothing in the Results table is real data yet. items.author: ninjahawk1
items.descZh: 针对前沿大模型（如 Claude Opus 5.5）在发布后可能因量化或路由调整被悄悄“削弱”的争议，livenerf 提供了一套长期、确定性的基准测试框架，旨在提供发布当日的干净基线以终结无依据的主观争论。该工具在模型自身无法保证确定性（无采样参数且无法关闭思考）的前提下，通过冻结提示词、锁定 CLI 版本、使用纯函数评分器及永久保留原始日志来确保测试环境的绝对可控。系统基于 UK AI Security Institute 的 Inspect 框架构建，并采用 Anthropic 自身的统计评估方法，通过数千个样本的统计漂移来精确量化模型能力变化。目前 v0 版本已通过无 API 密钥的 headless Claude Code 运行两轮 20 样本试点，首轮测试达成 20/20 满分，而第二轮测试揭示了安全过滤器触发 Claude Code 静默回退至旧版模型（如 Opus 4.8）的问题，相关样本已被剔除。该工具包含四个任务族、小时级调度器和配对差异分析模块，适用于需要长期、客观监控已发布模型版本迭代性能漂移的场景。
items.quote: livenerf 是一个小型、单调、仅追加的基准测试，用于回答一个问题：模型在发布后会变差吗？
